description: The message action bar follows long messages and flips clipped tooltips below. The screen is 390x667. "The message" is the last "[data-testid=\"message\"].message-agent"; "the entity" is its [data-content-entity="content"]; "the container" is the entity's closest ".messages-container"; "the action bar" is the entity's ".message-action-bar-wrapper"; "fork" is the action bar's button whose accessible name contains "Fork conversation from here". Accessible names: an element's name is its aria-label if it has one; otherwise a button's name is its text with whitespace collapsed and trimmed, leaving out aria-hidden parts, and a dialog's name is the text of the element its aria-labelledby refers to; "named X" means the name is exactly X. Only elements that are not display: none count. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. The message (allow 30s) and the entity should be visible. 3. In one eval on the entity: set its style.minHeight to "1000px"; add (entity top - container top + 96) to the container's scrollTop, using getBoundingClientRect() tops; then dispatch new MouseEvent("click", {bubbles: true}) on the entity. 4. The action bar should be visible. Its sticky inset, action bar top - container top (getBoundingClientRect), must be within 0.5 of 8. 5. Hover fork: it should get data-tooltip-placement="bottom". 6. In one eval: add (entity top - container top - 120) to the container's scrollTop, then dispatch new MouseEvent("mouseover", {bubbles: true, cancelable: true, composed: true}) on fork. 7. Fork should get data-tooltip-placement="top".
